title: Pure Heroic
summary: Heroic Challengers and their Rank 4 Heroic Champion Xyz bosses with generic staples. The deck swarms Level 4 EARTH Warriors and deliberately drops to 500 LP with Heroic Champion - Claivesolish to unlock bonus effects on Heroic Envoy and Heroic Call while pushing for one-hit OTKs.

summary.title: Starters
points: Heroic Envoy adds any Heroic monster from the Deck to the hand, and banishes itself from the GY at 500 or less LP to recover a Heroic card from the GY.

Heroic Challenger - Thousand Blades discards a Heroic card to Special Summon a Heroic monster from the Deck while locking you into Heroic monsters for the rest of the turn, and revives itself from the GY whenever you take damage.

Heroic Challenger - Morning Star Special Summons itself from the hand while you control 2 or more Warrior monsters, searches a Heroic Spell/Trap on summon, and revives itself from the GY at 500 or less LP.

summary.title: Opening: Thousand Blades + Any Heroic Card
steps: Normal Summon Heroic Challenger - Thousand Blades and discard a Heroic card to Special Summon Heroic Challenger - Clasp Sword from the Deck; Clasp Sword searches Heroic Challenger - Morning Star.
With two Warriors on the field, Special Summon Morning Star from your hand and search Heroic Call or Heroic Chance.
Overlay two Level 4 Heroic Challengers into Heroic Champion - Claivesolish and two more into Heroic Champion - Magnum Excalibur or Heroic Champion - Excalibur.

summary.title: Bosses & OTK Payoff
points: Heroic Champion - Claivesolish pays LP so you have 500 left to double the ATK of 1 monster on the field at the start of the Battle Phase, forces the opponent to attack only it, and detaches 1 material when an attack is declared to gain the ATK of an opponent's monster.
Heroic Champion - Magnum Excalibur equips itself from the field to another Warrior you control during either Main Phase to grant it +2000 ATK/DEF, and shuffles Warriors from the GY into the Deck.

Heroic Champion - Excalibur detaches 2 materials to double its original ATK to 4000, Heroic Champion - Gandiva destroys Special Summoned Level 4 or lower monsters, Heroic Champion - Kusanagi negates Traps, and Heroic Champion - Jarngreipr protects Warriors and revives a Rank 4 Xyz.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Heroic Call Special Summons a Warrior from your hand or GY, or banishes itself from the GY at 500 or less LP to grant a monster +500 ATK per Heroic card on the field or attached as Xyz Material.
Heroic Chance doubles a face-up Heroic monster's ATK for the turn, while Heroic Retribution Sword equips to a Heroic monster to reflect battle damage and destroy the battling monster.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Number 86: Heroic Champion - Rhongomyniad is Forbidden in the TCG.
